title: alcea lavateriflora
intro: Alcea lavateriflora, commonly known as Lavatera, is a plant species in the mallow family. The Lavatera plant is used in traditional medicine and is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, providing health benefits such as wound healing and protection against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Lavatera include calming and soothing the skin, reducing inflammation, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Lavatera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
